nodes.text:
Is the CCP trying to cover up a new outbreak of Covid-19 by calling it HMPV?
If China had shared more data in 2019 instead of censoring the virus, this second wave of infections might not have happened. 
If this is a return of COVID, they only have themselves to blame.
